content.value: A counter flow heat exchanger of heat transfer area 14 $\mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ is to cool oil with water. The oil enters at $1 0 5 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ with mass flow rate of 2.5 kg/sec, while the water enters at $2 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ with mass flow rate of 0.5 kg/sec. The overall heat transfer coefficient is $\mathrm { U } = 4 5 0 ~ \mathrm { W / m ^ { \circ } C }$ Calculate the exit temperature of water and the total heat transfer rate.
